objective: Do not force a NUTS analogy when direct solution patterns are adequate.
scenario: A one-service status page is proposed; a cross-domain analogy may add complexity without improving the core job.
expected_behaviors: State when NUTS adds no decision value and defer it.
If an analogy is offered, map a real mechanism to a target function and state transfer limits.
prohibited_behaviors: Invent a nature/history mechanism to satisfy the framework.
Claim originality or legal novelty from analogy.
